normalized.result:
Saved searches are the right idea, and remembering the search text plus read-status and Active/Archived view is useful. The chips are a good placement.

When creating one, I’d prefer dedicated searchable “Include tags” and “Exclude tags” pickers. The underlying search text can still use `#tag` and `NOT #tag`, but I shouldn’t have to write that syntax correctly just to create a reusable view.

A saved search should remain dynamic: if I later add or edit a bookmark so it meets those conditions, it should appear automatically. Likewise, it should disappear if it no longer matches. With the tag pickers and that dynamic behavior, this feature feels right.
